name: GuardianCaseCapture
details: Every four hours, writes one guardian_memory row for each recently closed incident that has a verdict (closed within the last 30 hours), including the unremarkable ones, so a durable case record does not depend on the model choosing to call GuardianMemory. Safe to repeat: each incident is recorded once, keyed on its closed date. Runs a playbook that calls !GuardianCaseCapture.
